title: Bluesky
description: Social network where newcomers are announced
status: stable
groma:
  id: bluesky
  technology: AT Protocol XRPC
---

The portfolio-alert.bsky.social account posts each night's newcomers as a post or a short thread. The nightly job signs in with an app password stored as a GitHub secret. Posts that turn out wrong can be deleted the same way.
